card.name: Website footer and disclaimer wording
card.fires_on: Words in stock website boilerplate, such as 'information' in a man-page colophon, 'medical' in a not-a-substitute-for-care disclaimer, and 'look' in 'What made you want to look up'.

modes.label: Disclaimer and colophon text
modes.description: A noun or adjective inside a standard notice about information, professional care or reporting bugs.
modes.example: The resources on this site should not be used as a substitute for professional<< medical>> care or advice.

modes.label: Dictionary look-up prompt
modes.description: The verb 'look' in the dictionary site prompt asking what made you want to look up a word.
modes.example: What made you want to<< look>> up "tenor drum"? Please share

card.writes: Weak and mixed; the promoted tokens are mostly Chinese words about time, work and study, so no clear English effect.
card.plain: It lights up on a key word in the stock notices found at the bottom of web pages.
